verdict.rationale: Trello documents a first-party capability to view work from Jira in a Trello list (trello-docs-27), which brings one other project management tool's tasks into a Trello view. The Inbox captures items from email and Slack, but those are not project management tools. The generic Power-Ups and app-linking claims don't show a unified cross-tool task view. Missing for 10: aggregation across multiple PM tools beyond Jira, filtering to the engineer's own assigned tasks, a single unified cross-tool view, independent or hands-on corroboration.
